summary: FirstSun Capital Bancorp filed an 8-K to report that its subsidiary Sunflower Bank completed the sale of approximately $336 million in performing municipal loans to an unaffiliated third party. This sale was part of the balance sheet repositioning announced in connection with FirstSun's acquisition of First Foundation Inc., which closed on April 1, 2026. Proceeds will be used to pay down high-cost deposits acquired from First Foundation. The filing updates progress on post-acquisition integration, not a new special situation event. No deal terms are disclosed.
